meta.parties: Somasunderam Pillai Et Al. v. Charavanamuttu Et Al

rules.statement: A person governed by the Tesawalamai must affirmatively establish that they are an inhabitant of Jaffna, and this determination is based on the facts of each case.
rules.supporting_quote: "As the Tesawalamai is a custom in derogation of the common law, any person who alleges that it is applicable to him must affirmatively establish the fact"
